==Notes==
*This skill mimics the effect of the [[Guild Lord]]'s [[Amulet of Protection]].
*Under Angelic Protection, you take the damage first and then are healed. If you take more damage than you have [[health]] remaining, you will die.
*Unlike [[Protective Spirit]], this skill will protect even against small damage [[packet]]s if there are enough of them. An example would be the large mobs of [[Avicara Fierce]] in [[Mineral Springs]] who use [[Ignite Arrows]] and [[Dual Shot]].
*The effect of this skill isn't triggered by sacrificing health from skills such as [[Blood is Power]].
{{Skill change}}
